data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed both PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO, finding a standard binary package with pinned checksums downloading from the official GitHub repository (github.com/penso/herdr-gpui). The package() function only performs standard installation commands. The qwen model's inconclusive result was due to API errors (HTTP 400), not security concerns. Even its initial PKGBUILD audit found no dangerous top-level code. No injection patterns, no unexpected network destinations, no obfuscation.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is not substantive - it's a technical failure. The qwen model experienced API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when attempting to audit both files, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully completed its review and found the package safe. The qwen model's initial PKGBUILD audit (before the API errors) also found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete file audits due to API errors (HTTP 400)
learnings: API errors should be clearly distinguished from security findings - the qwen model's inconclusive result was due to infrastructure failure, not package concerns
When one model has technical failures and another succeeds with thorough review, the successful review should carry appropriate weight
Initial PKGBUILD audits that succeed before file-level API failures can provide useful signal about top-level safety
